app.name: SupportOne
app.tagline: Reads your computer, explains what it finds, changes nothing without asking.
agent.build.unsigned: This is an unsigned development build.
agent.checks.none: This build has no diagnostic checks compiled in yet.
agent.dry_run.active: Dry run: nothing on this computer will be changed.
agent.platform.unsupported: The SupportOne agent runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. This computer is not one of them.
check.unknown.tool_missing: Could not check: %s is not installed on this computer.
check.unknown.failed: This check could not finish, so there is no answer to report.
check.unknown.needs_admin: This check needs administrator rights to read what it reads.
check.os.info.ok: Running %s %s. It has been on for %s.
check.hardware.inventory.unreported: This computer does not report its make and model. It has a %s (%d cores).
check.hardware.ram.low: Only %s of memory. A current operating system and a few browser tabs will feel slow on this; more memory is the single biggest improvement you could make.
check.battery.health.absent: No battery — this is a desktop computer.
check.battery.health.ok: The battery is in good shape: it still holds %d%% of the charge it held when new.
check.battery.health.worn: The battery holds %d%% of the charge it held when new. It will not last as long away from a charger; plan to replace it.
check.battery.health.failing: The battery holds only %d%% of the charge it held when new and should be replaced.
check.battery.health.unreadable: There is a battery, but this computer does not report enough about it to judge its health.
check.disk.volumes.ok: %d drives checked. The one with the least room, %s, still has %s free.
check.disk.volumes.low: %s is running low on room: %s free (%s%%). Clearing space now avoids trouble later.
check.disk.volumes.critical: %s is nearly full: %s free (%s%%). At this level programs start failing to save files.
check.disk.volumes.none: No drives could be read on this computer.
check.disk.smart.ok.one: %d drive checked, and it reports itself healthy.
check.disk.smart.failing: The drive %s reports that it is failing. Back up your files now and plan to replace it.
check.disk.smart.bad_spots: The drive %s has %d bad spots it has had to stop using. It still works, but this is how a disk begins to fail: back up your files and keep an eye on it.
check.disk.smart.unknown: No drive would report its health. That is normal for USB drives and some laptops, and is not a sign of a problem.
check.disk.smart.no_disks: No drives were found to check.
check.network.config.ok: Connected on %s, through the router at %s.
check.network.config.no_address: This computer has no network address, so it is not connected to any network.
check.network.config.no_gateway: Connected on %s, but there is no route out to the internet. Other devices in the building may work; websites will not.
check.network.config.no_dns: Connected on %s, but no DNS server is set, so website names cannot be looked up.
check.network.config.interfaces_unreadab: The network connections could not be read.
check.drivers.problem.ok: Every device reports that it is working.
check.drivers.problem.not_applicable: This check only applies to Windows, which is where devices report an error state.
check.startup.items.ok: %d programs start on their own when you log in.
check.startup.items.ok.one: %d program starts on its own when you log in.
check.startup.items.none: Nothing is set to start on its own when you log in.
check.updates.os.ok: Updates were last installed %d days ago.
check.updates.os.pending: %d updates are waiting to be installed.
check.updates.os.pending.one: %d update is waiting to be installed.
check.updates.os.stale: Updates were last installed %d days ago, so security fixes released since then are missing.
check.updates.os.very_stale: Updates were last installed %d days ago. This computer is missing months of security fixes.
check.updates.os.unknown: This computer keeps no record of when it last installed updates.
check.security.posture.ok: Disk encryption, the firewall and antivirus all report as expected.
check.security.posture.no_encryption: The disk is not encrypted. If this computer is lost or stolen, the files on it can be read.
check.security.posture.no_antivirus: No antivirus is running on this computer.
check.security.posture.unreadable: None of the security settings could be read from this account.
check.eventlog.errors.none: The system recorded no errors about itself in the last %d days.
check.eventlog.errors.quiet: %d errors in the last %d days, none of them repeating. Every computer logs some; this is normal.
check.eventlog.errors.quiet.one: %d error in the last %d days, and nothing repeating. Every computer logs some; this is normal.
check.eventlog.errors.repeated: %s has failed %d times in the last %d days. Something there is going wrong over and over.
check.eventlog.errors.critical: %d serious system events in the last %d days, such as the computer restarting unexpectedly.
check.eventlog.errors.critical.one: %d serious system event in the last %d days, such as the computer restarting unexpectedly.
report.title: Computer health report
report.subtitle: What SupportOne read from this computer. It changed nothing.
report.no_findings: Nothing here needs your attention. That is a real result, not an empty page.
report.skipped_note: These checks need administrator rights and were not run. A check that did not run is not a check that passed.
report.about_body: Every line above was read from this computer; nothing was changed and nothing was sent anywhere. Checks that could not get an answer say so rather than reporting that all is well.
report.redacted: Identifying details have been removed from this copy at the request of the person who generated it.
ui.heading: Your computer's health
ui.subheading: SupportOne read this computer and changed nothing. Nothing leaves this machine unless you save or send it yourself.
ui.nothing_wrong: Nothing here needs your attention. That is a real result, not an empty page.
ui.skipped_note: These need administrator rights and were not run. A check that did not run is not a check that passed.
ui.redaction_note: The report is saved to this computer, not sent anywhere. Choose what to take out first, then see exactly what would be left.
